Reuse the bounded transforms in a39b954:lab/sizing.py through a future isolated port of that file and tests/test_sizing.py, without importing the old PR's engine or frozen-lane changes. All 10 existing synthetic sizing tests passed in the read-only audit; this is code verification, not a market result.

sizing.apply_multiplier accepts one scalar multiplier per time row for a complete signed-notional position matrix, including any hedge. It is not a per-pair weighted cross-venue ledger. lab/xfund.py uses equal-unit legs; weighted sizing still requires quantities, weighted price/funding PnL and turnover/fees on rebalances.

lab/levcarry.py is a simplified sensitivity model: unavailable adverse ranges become zero, maintenance margin is constant, and iso_hold cumulative equity excludes accumulated funding. Account mechanics still need fair-price paths, venue/tier-specific margin, contract rounding, funding/fee cash flows, liquidation execution, collateral/transfer constraints and partial or rejected hedge handling.

A future confidence lane must define a forecast target, horizon, past-only estimates, uncertainty and matched exposure controls before measuring. Raw score magnitude, agreement or spread persistence is not calibrated probability. Neither these helpers nor leverage establishes profit or creates alpha.
